sloka: स ताम् दृष्ट्वा ततः पंपाम् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ।विललाप च तेजस्वी कामात् दशरथात्मजः ॥३-७५-२२॥
transliteration: sa tām dṛṣṭvā tataḥ paṁpām rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ।vilalāpa ca tejasvī kāmāt daśarathātmajaḥ ॥3-75-22॥

translations.english: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: हे लदमण ! यह बसन्त ऋतु विविध प्रकार के पत्तियों से नादित हो, मेरे सीता-वियोग-जन्य शोक को बढ़ा रहा है
